achievements.name: Hello, Overworld!
achievements.description: Record your first activity. Your lantern is ready to run.
achievements.condition: At least one valid Activity entry on a date no later than today.
achievements.fiction: Your character lights the Runlight Lantern and leaves the training hall as an adventurer.
achievements.rationale: Turns a mundane first log into a small departure scene; the programmer greeting becomes a world outside the screen.
achievements.motivation: Immediate belonging, curiosity and an attainable first collectible.
achievements.role: Beginning; normally the first explicit Activity save.
achievements.unlock: Runlight lit. Adventure is now executing.
achievements.reward: Runlight Lantern, commemorated by the badge; no equip action or stat modifier.
achievements.metaphor: A brass travelling lantern containing an amber triangular Run crystal.
achievements.direction: Round bronze medallion, midnight teal leather, large lantern and warm contained light; restrained starter ornament.
achievements.next: The collection shows several paths worth exploring; no compulsory next quest.
achievements.examples: One valid kickback, a timed custom movement or a distance log qualifies. Creating a custom definition or goal alone does not.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Push to Main
achievements.description: Log 32 push-ups across at least 3 days. The main branch has muscle.
achievements.condition: Lifetime pushups/reps total >= 32, with pushups/reps recorded on at least 3 distinct eligible dates.
achievements.fiction: Your character earns the Gauntlet of the Main Branch, strong enough to hold the guild's standard aloft.
achievements.rationale: The Git phrase and push-up action share a natural verb. A gauntlet makes the strength gain tangible.
achievements.motivation: Specialisation, competence and a joke worth remembering.
achievements.role: Approachable strength distinction, spread over several dates.
achievements.reward: Gauntlet of the Main Branch, illustrated recognition.
achievements.metaphor: A broad armoured gauntlet lifting a branching gold standard.
achievements.direction: Cobalt circular medallion, bronze cuff and warm gold gauntlet, one large upward fork as a standard; no anatomical figure.
achievements.next: Merge Quest offers a different use for the same repetition activity.
achievements.examples: 31 reps on 3 dates fails; 32 on 2 fails; 32 on 3 passes. Custom activities named Push-ups do not alias the built-in ID.
achievements.dependencies: Common adapter plus a unit-specific total and distinct-date predicate.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Leg Day Compiler
achievements.description: Compile 64 squats across at least 3 days. Forge a sturdier foundation.
achievements.condition: Lifetime squats/reps total >= 64, with squats/reps recorded on at least 3 distinct eligible dates.
achievements.fiction: The forge finishes your Foundation Greaves; your character's stance becomes the anchor of the party.
achievements.rationale: Repetitions become build inputs, and the completed object is leg armour rather than another abstract medal.
achievements.motivation: Fictional strength, craftsmanship and optional specialisation.
achievements.role: Early-to-intermediate strength counterpart to Push to Main.
achievements.unlock: Compilation complete. Your stance has been upgraded.
achievements.metaphor: A pair of heavy bronze greaves being finished on a compact anvil.
achievements.direction: Oxblood circular medallion, broad gold-bronze armoured shins and boots, compact dark anvil base, a small ruby focal point; no person.
achievements.next: Personal goals and mixed movement can turn the greaves into part of an imagined kit.
achievements.examples: 64 squats on one date does not qualify. Split entries on the same date contribute amounts but count as one date.
achievements.dependencies: Same existing-data predicate as Push to Main, separately configured.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Cache Me Outside
achievements.description: Log 5 km or 60 minutes of walking in total. There's treasure beyond the desk.
achievements.condition: Lifetime walking/metres >= 5000 OR lifetime walking/seconds >= 3600. Each branch is counted separately.
achievements.fiction: Your character discovers the Leafneedle Compass in a wayside cache and earns a first explorer's keepsake.
achievements.rationale: The cache joke connects developer life and an outdoor treasure; walking is a real adventure path rather than a lesser run.
achievements.motivation: Exploration, humour and flexible access without needing distance tracking.
achievements.role: Early exploration milestone; may arrive in one long walk or many short walks.
achievements.unlock: Cache found. Contents: one very good reason to wander.
achievements.reward: Leafneedle Compass, a fictional discovery represented by the badge.
achievements.metaphor: An open brass compass with a large emerald leaf as its needle.
achievements.direction: Deep moss circular medallion, brass compass case, bold green leaf, small parchment edge; avoid another boot like the existing First Step.
achievements.next: Full Stack Adventurer invites a different discipline without invalidating walking.
achievements.examples: 2500 m plus 1800 s fails: those branches are not added. 3600 s alone passes. Recording both measurements never doubles progress.
achievements.dependencies: Common adapter plus two alternative unit-specific totals.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Runtime Ranger
achievements.description: Log 10 km or 90 minutes of running across at least 3 days. Carry the guild's message.
achievements.condition: Either running/metres total >= 10000 on >= 3 dates with running/metres, OR running/seconds total >= 5400 on >= 3 dates with running/seconds.
achievements.fiction: Your character becomes a Runtime Ranger and is entrusted with the guild's windglass dispatch.
achievements.rationale: Runtime becomes time spent running; the courier artefact gives endurance a story without claiming a speed test.
achievements.motivation: Specialist identity and a desirable mid-collection object.
achievements.unlock: Dispatch entrusted. The road knows your runtime.
achievements.reward: Windglass Dispatch and the narrative title Runtime Ranger; no class selector.
achievements.metaphor: A winged bronze hourglass with ruby sand.
achievements.direction: Deep wine medallion, generous pale-gold wings and large hourglass, ruby sand; distinct from the cycling wheel.
achievements.next: Long-Term Support values returning, whichever movement follows.
achievements.progressCopy: {km}/10 km on {metreDays}/3 days OR {minutes}/90 min on {secondDays}/3 days
achievements.examples: 10 km on 2 distance dates plus a separate seconds-only date fails the distance branch. The branch reaching its threshold must also have 3 dates.
achievements.dependencies: Common adapter plus alternative amount/date pairs; no pace inference.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Cycle of Power
achievements.description: Log 25 km or 120 minutes of cycling across at least 3 days. Wake the wayfarer wheel.
achievements.condition: Either cycling/metres total >= 25000 on >= 3 dates with cycling/metres, OR cycling/seconds total >= 7200 on >= 3 dates with cycling/seconds.
achievements.fiction: Your character awakens the Wayfarer Wheel, a relic that once powered the guild's distant outposts.
achievements.rationale: A mechanical cycle becomes an enchanted power cycle; the cyclist earns an artefact with its own silhouette.
achievements.motivation: Specialisation, mechanical fantasy and accumulated endurance.
achievements.role: Intermediate cycling path; the time route also accommodates stationary cycling.
achievements.unlock: Power cycle complete. The old wheel turns again.
achievements.metaphor: A large brass spoked wheel with a sapphire axle and two readable pedal arms.
achievements.direction: Deep teal mechanical medallion with a scalloped cog-like outer rim; gold wheel and blue centre; no glowing dashboard or tiny bicycle scene.
achievements.next: The wheel sits alongside the other specialisations rather than outranking them.
achievements.progressCopy: {km}/25 km on {metreDays}/3 days OR {minutes}/120 min on {secondDays}/3 days
achievements.examples: Stationary cycling recorded in seconds can qualify; no GPS, speed or outdoor location is required. Metres and seconds are alternative branches.
achievements.dependencies: Same bounded predicate as Runtime Ranger with cycling configuration.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Full Stack Adventurer
achievements.description: Try 3 different activities. Fill your adventurer's toolkit.
achievements.condition: At least 3 distinct activityId values among eligible entries. Built-ins and custom definitions count equally; measurement units do not create new types.
achievements.fiction: Your character receives a field pack stocked for more than one kind of adventure.
achievements.rationale: Full stack is breadth of practice, not maximal volume; one memorable backpack packages that breadth.
achievements.motivation: Experimentation and collection for casual and versatile players.
achievements.role: Early exploratory side path; kickbacks and custom activities are fully eligible.
achievements.unlock: Toolkit expanded. You are more than a one-button hero.
achievements.reward: Full Stack Field Pack, fictional kit only.
achievements.metaphor: A substantial leather field pack with a rolled map, compact training weight and walking staff.
achievements.direction: Broad bronze-gold shield, slate-blue lining, warm leather backpack dominant; three secondary tools stay subordinate.
achievements.next: Fork Your Path rewards making one of those activities your own.
achievements.examples: Walking metres and walking seconds count as one ID. An archived custom activity's historical entries still count. A rename does not create a new type.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Merge Quest
achievements.description: On one day, log 10 reps of one activity and 1 km or 10 minutes of another. Two branches. One quest.
achievements.condition: On at least one eligible date d, some activity A totals >= 10 reps and a DIFFERENT activity B totals >= 1000 metres OR >= 600 seconds. Sum only the same date, activity and unit.
achievements.fiction: Two training paths join and the guild's Merge Gate opens to your character.
achievements.rationale: The merge is what the player actually did: combined a strength-style and a travel/time-style discipline on a single day.
achievements.motivation: A small optional trial, discovery and a satisfying combination.
achievements.role: Playful intermediate side quest; not an exercise prescription or order-sensitive workout.
achievements.unlock: Branches merged. A new gate opens.
achievements.reward: Merge Gate crest and a one-line story event; no world-map unlock.
achievements.metaphor: Emerald and cobalt causeways join at a substantial golden gate.
achievements.direction: Plum-backed eight-sided medallion; clean Y composition, broad paths and large gate. No tiny scene or human silhouettes.
achievements.next: A combination achievement makes existing activities feel useful in a new way.
achievements.progressCopy: One day: {reps}/10 reps + ({km}/1 km OR {minutes}/10 min of another activity)
achievements.examples: 10 kickbacks plus 600 s walking on the same date passes. 10 squats today plus 1 km tomorrow fails. Different units on the same custom ID cannot form the pair.
achievements.dependencies: Common adapter plus a grouped same-date pair predicate; no timed session or sequence system.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Build Passed
achievements.description: Meet all your enabled goals on 3 days. A build worthy of the guild.
achievements.condition: At least 3 eligible dates with >= 1 entry, a saved ActivityDay goal snapshot containing >= 1 enabled goal, and every enabled snapshot goal meeting its target using that date's matching activityId/unit entries.
achievements.fiction: The guild's forge approves three completed training plans and stamps your character's Build Seal.
achievements.rationale: A green build passes the plan the player chose, giving personal goals a meaningful place beside fixed milestones.
achievements.motivation: Autonomy, competence and the satisfaction of finishing a small plan.
achievements.role: Early-to-intermediate; rewards chosen goals without raising them automatically.
achievements.unlock: Build passed. All planned systems green.
achievements.reward: Guild Build Seal, represented by an emerald check forged over an anvil.
achievements.metaphor: A chunky bronze anvil carrying a single faceted emerald check.
achievements.direction: Indigo hexagonal crest, warm hammered metal, bright green check as focal shape; no checklists or embedded lettering.
achievements.next: Invites continuing a manageable plan; does not add a harder goal.
achievements.progressCopy: {completeGoalDays}/3 days with all enabled goals met
achievements.examples: Zero enabled goals never passes. An empty historical snapshot never borrows today's plan. A custom goal can qualify. Extra activity beyond a target does not invalidate a day.
achievements.dependencies: Common adapter plus full-history snapshot goal evaluation reusing goalProgress; the current recentActivityDays helper covers only 7 days and is insufficient by itself.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Fork Your Path
achievements.description: Log one custom activity on 3 different days. Make your own trail.
achievements.condition: At least one non-builtin ActivityDefinition ID has eligible entries on >= 3 distinct dates, in its supported unit. Historical entries remain eligible if that definition is archived.
achievements.fiction: Your character carves a Trailfork Staff; the guild recognises a path that did not appear in its training manual.
achievements.rationale: Customisation matters only when used. Three dates turn creating a label into a small identity.
achievements.motivation: Ownership, self-expression and inclusion of preferred or adapted movement.
achievements.role: Exploratory personal path, without defining a new class or trusting an activity name.
achievements.unlock: Trail forked. This branch is yours.
achievements.metaphor: A split wooden staff bearing an emerald crystal on one fork and a small bronze gear on the other.
achievements.direction: Copper octagonal frame, deep russet backing, large simple staff, restrained leaf and gear accents; clearly different from the rooted veteran tree.
achievements.next: Any custom movement also contributes to the general day milestones.
achievements.progressCopy: {days}/3 days using the same custom activity
achievements.examples: Three different custom IDs used once each fails. A rename keeps progress; archiving keeps history. Creating a custom definition without entries does not qualify.
achievements.dependencies: Common adapter plus custom-ID membership and per-ID distinct dates; no semantic classification of custom names.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Warm Reboot
achievements.description: Return after 7 full days away, or log activity on 14 days in total. Your campfire remembers.
achievements.condition: Either two adjacent distinct eligible activity dates have >= 7 full calendar dates with no eligible entries BETWEEN them (date difference >= 8), OR there are >= 14 distinct eligible activity dates.
achievements.fiction: Your character's campfire flares up again. The adventure kept a place for you.
achievements.rationale: Offers a welcome after an ordinary break while the alternative route lets consistent players collect it without deliberately stopping.
achievements.motivation: Return, reassurance without a lecture, and continuity of character identity.
achievements.role: Recovery or steady participation; optional timing, one award only.
achievements.unlock: Welcome back to the fire. Your story still has its place.
achievements.metaphor: A heavy iron camp brazier with a warm gold flame and a broad curved restart-arrow ornament.
achievements.direction: Oxidised bronze round frame, deep plum interior, squat dark brazier and bold amber flame; distinct from the starter lantern.
achievements.next: Long-Term Support counts every active date, including those on either side of a break.
achievements.progressCopy: Return after 7 full inactive days OR {days}/14 active days
achievements.examples: Activity on 1 Oct and 9 Oct qualifies via 7 blank dates; 1 Oct and 8 Oct does not. Waiting without returning never qualifies. Fourteen scattered active dates always qualifies.
achievements.dependencies: Common adapter plus calendar-date gap scan OR activeDates; do not infer inactivity from time since last app visit.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required

achievements.name: Long-Term Support
achievements.description: Record activity on 42 different days. Become a pillar of the guild.
achievements.condition: At least 42 distinct eligible activity dates, using any supported built-in or custom activity. Dates need not be consecutive.
achievements.fiction: The guild names your character a Pillar of the Long Road and raises a living oak crest in their honour.
achievements.rationale: LTS turns returning over time into a developer's veteran identity. The tree embodies support and growth instead of just a larger number.
achievements.motivation: Long-term identity, prestige and a striking final collectible.
achievements.role: Aspirational anchor; earliest 42 active dates, with no expiry or missed-day reset.
achievements.unlock: Long-Term Support granted. The guild has roots because you returned.
achievements.reward: Pillar of the Long Road title in narrative copy and the Living Oak Crest; no title-management UI.
achievements.metaphor: A mighty oak rooted in a foundation stone with a sapphire in its trunk.
achievements.direction: Emerald shield, gold-bronze trunk, compact leaf canopy, gold roots and short laurel sprigs. The richest frame, but tree silhouette dominates.
achievements.next: The distinction celebrates the ongoing adventure; earning all twelve is not required.
achievements.examples: 42 logs on one date count once. Any 42 dates pass. This corresponds to existing Activity Level 7 (1 + floor(42/7)), but the badge does not award levels.
achievements.visibility: visible from the collection; no hidden-achievement mechanism required
